propositions: A commit whose subject exceeds 50 characters is rejected locally with a named error message.
A commit whose body contains a line exceeding 72 characters is rejected locally, naming each offending line and its length.
A conforming commit succeeds and still receives Gerrit's Change-Id trailer via the chained commit-msg.legacy hook without clobbering the existing hook.
Body lines matching trailer, tag, fence, indent, table, or atomic-token patterns are exempt from the 72-character limit per the specified detection rules.
The check-only checker never mutates the commit message and integrates as a commit-msg stage hook in pre-commit with default_install_hook_types specified.
make hooks verifies both pre-commit and commit-msg hooks are installed, exits non-zero if either is missing, and warns (exit zero) if no Change-Id stamping is found.
